exclusions.reason: The browser calls /api/chat; only the interface backend invokes Databricks.
Genie exists in compatibility code but is not represented as a production capability in these tracked paths.
Selection and SafeToolExecutor retain policy authority; skills cannot grant tools.
Agent conversation state is off in the tracked production target.
Draft packages emit a warning, so the visual does not imply universal production approval.
Only public summaries are rendered; private chain-of-thought is not exposed.
move-istruzioni is a separate versioned prompt and document application, not the publisher of current file-backed ADG packages.
The diagrams show system boundaries and contain no customer or production payload.
